paraphrase: A reason may be present in all, some or none of the similar cases, and in all, some or none of the dissimilar cases; of the nine combinations, only presence in (all or some) similar cases with absence from all dissimilar cases gives a valid reason; presence only in dissimilar cases gives a contrary reason; the remaining five are inconclusive.
notes: Structure of the wheel recalled (valid: positions 2 and 8; contrary: 4 and 6).
